reason: Article 14(1) requires effective human oversight. Article 14(4)(d) explicitly supports the ability to override or reverse the AI system's output, and Article 14(4)(e) supports the availability of a stop button. These provisions directly and materially support the main control objective of having human review, rejection, stop, override, and escalation capabilities.
